name: voice-agent-platform
description: Provider-agnostic AI voice agent platform (Twilio + LLM + TTS + STT adapters) with multi-tenant config and OpenTelemetry observability.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @platform/core && npm run build -w @platform/observability && npm run build -w @platform/config && npm run build -w @platform/data && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-mock && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-twilio && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-deepgram && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-openai && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-elevenlabs && npm run build -w @platform/adapters-calcom && npm run build -w @platform/engine && npm run build -w @platform/voice-agent
